title: Workspace Scan.toml as the default of each package
description: The root Scan.toml sets [rule], [gate] and [analysis]. A package uses either its own Scan.toml as a whole or, when it has none, the workspace one; nothing is merged. inherits has no Scan.toml and uses the workspace file (its tests are excluded and its ballerina:13 issue too). own_gate has its own file with only failOnCount = 3, so it has no rule exclusions, no test exclusion and no severity. own_rule has its own file with include = [], so it has no gate at all. Each package with its own file gets one warning listing the workspace settings it does not apply. The analyzer rule in the root [rule] is not a rule of inherits, so it gets a warning.

steps.name: Scan
steps.note: Stage 1 warnings for own_gate and own_rule. Only inherits uses failOnSeverity = "LOW".

steps.name: --fail-on-severity=NONE
steps.note: Passes; the stage 2 warning names the workspace Scan.toml once (only inherits uses it).

steps.name: --fail-on-count=3
steps.note: Only the count is replaced. inherits keeps failOnSeverity = "LOW" from the workspace file; own_gate's file writes failOnCount = 3, so no warning for it.

steps.name: --scan-report
steps.note: The HTML report leaves out inherits/tests/main_test.bal.

steps.name: bal scan inside a package
steps.note: Inside a workspace package, bal scan still scans the whole workspace (as in ws-04), so the result matches the first step.
